title: Draw Stacking
description: Stack +2 and +4 draw cards to pass the penalty to the next player. A draw-penalty (+2/+4) play records its N as vanilla:draw_debt on the next seat and opens a response window for that victim only (`responders` `@next_player`). The victim may answer with the same draw value as the top (+2 on +2, +4 on +4; `plays_stack_response`): the engine carries the accumulated debt on to the seat after the responder, hands the responder the turn and re-opens the window (`reopen`). When the victim does not stack, the default route has them draw the whole debt, clears it and skips their turn. The match_start allow rescues only such a window reply from vanilla:turn_order; it never makes a +2 playable on an unrelated card. The +2/+4 cards' own immediate draw is removed by this mod's mutations, so the penalty lives only as debt.
